model_visible.current_grid: last frame as integer grid, label-free
model_visible.available_actions: opaque names only: ACTION1..ACTION7; RESET is runtime-controlled
model_visible.recent_interactions: agent's own prior observation/action/outcome evidence only
model_visible.retrieved_model_world: GrapheneDB evidence/hypotheses with provenance; no oracle labels

runner_may_use_for_control_only: levels_completed and win_levels for post-hoc evaluation
rationale: A1.5 isolates unknown-world reasoning from visual perception. A later visual embodiment treatment may replace this adapter with screenshot/video perception while keeping the same dialectical reasoning substrate.
